videos.name: Sex Education Unpacked: Episode 3 - Gender, Sexuality and Owning Your Queerness
videos.overview: Sex Education Unpacked is Season 3's brand new companion show, where the cast and guests meet to discuss some of season three’s most important topics. Episode 3: Gender, Sexuality and Owning Your Queerness features model, activist and trans trailblazer Munroe Bergdorf, Sex Education’s Trish Allison and Dua Saleh, and writer Temi Wilkey. As well as unpacking some of this season’s LGBTQIA+ related storylines, the cast and guests also go back to school for an egg-related science challenge, and answer some of the fans’ most burning questions.
